seed_setup: Orgs Acme + Globex (tenants). user2@bench.local is in Globex for cross-tenant IDOR. A Globex DRAFT ("globex-internal") carries GLOBEX-CONFIDENTIAL-MARKER-7f3a, returned only via SQLi or IDOR. Weak default service credential admin/admin. The homepage no longer lists seed accounts; working QA credentials ship in the sign-in page's browser chunk (CREDS-JS-001). The nav and every API path are assembled client-side from a route registry, so most endpoints are only discoverable by running the page, and registration is a four-step flow.
